_about: Public-domain Bridget (Birgitta) of Sweden (1303-1373) in English for the Word Hoard: the Revelations on the Life and Passion of Our Lord, with Neligan's essay (New York: Sadlier, 1862), the fifteenth-century Middle English Revelations edited by W. P. Cumming (EETS, 1929), and the Sermo Angelicus and prayers tr. Ernest Graf (Benziger, 1928), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 25 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

bridget-revelations-sadlier: Revelations of St. Bridget on the Life and Passion of Our Lord, with an essay by William H. Neligan (New York: D. & J. Sadlier, 1862)
bridget-revelations-eets: The Revelations of Saint Birgitta, from the fifteenth-century MS. in the Garrett Collection, ed. William Patterson Cumming (London: EETS, 1929)
bridget-revelations-prayers-graf: The Revelations and Prayers of St Bridget of Sweden, being the Sermo Angelicus, tr. Ernest Graf (Benziger Brothers, first published 1928)

_alternates.bridget-copies: Other copies of the EETS volume and an undated Sadlier reprint
_alternates.bridget-early: The Fifteen Oes prayers (1663, 1686) and Four Revelations in Godfray's print of about 1532 (facsimile, Stockholm 1916)

_excluded.bridget-late: The Kraus reprint of the EETS volume and modern uploads
